title: Factory PMI hits a nine-month high of 56.0
takeaways: Flash manufacturing PMI rose to 56.0 from 54.7 in October.
Manufacturing output index climbed to 58.3 from 57.0.
Services activity eased to 55.3; composite edged up to 56.3.
Finished-goods stocks rose at the fastest pace since March 2005.
Official IIP growth slowed to 6.7% in September 2026.
source_note: Sources: HSBC Flash India PMI via Business Standard; DD News
